outcome: Source evidence and observations preserve meaning without becoming scoring inputs.

artifacts.purpose: SourceDefinition, Observation, ObservationSet/Definition, PreparationDescriptor and complete Prediction<Output> record

interfaces: Input: source definitions and row observation DTOs; output: checked source map and ObservationSet.
Closed Observation variants: Scalar, Bernoulli, ReportedConfidence, Categorical, LabelMarginals.
Preparation evidence_indices bind unique in-range source evidence-array entries; filesystem verification belongs to T011.

Construct Prediction<Output> with episode/source IDs, concrete output and a real checked ObservationSet; no raw-value or empty-type placeholder. This record moves from T003 because it depends on T004 observation semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Observation numbers must be finite; bounded variants use [0,1]; vector keys are nonblank and vectors nonempty.
Observed categorical sums are not normalized or bound to task vocabulary; omitted observations remain unavailable.
Unknown observation names/kind mismatches use E_PROVENANCE; invalid observation numeric values use E_OBSERVATION; unknown shape/kind uses schema error.
Source metadata and descriptor shapes are strict; unused source definitions are retained.

verification.expected: Every variant validates and retains exact meaning, including sum 0.99 and scalar/mean disagreement.
Blank/unknown sources, missing definitions, duplicate/out-of-range/empty evidence indices fail.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
